arrays.atlas.motor_rows: uint32[815], global canonical MaleCNS row indices
arrays.atlas.motor_mask: float32[92,815], 1 permits a learned weight; 0 structurally forbids it
arrays.atlas.motor_cohort_index: uint32[815], optional fine-cohort index; 4294967295 means unresolved
arrays.atlas.fine_cohort_mask: uint8[156,815], diagnostic author target cohorts; not a runtime bottleneck
arrays.atlas.afferent_rows: uint32[11798], nonvisual peripheral and ascending sensory canonical rows
arrays.atlas.afferent_port_mask: uint8[60,11798], author annotation support for named ports
arrays.atlas.joint_position_afferent_mask: uint8[126,11798], inferred anatomical support; zero means unsupported
arrays.atlas.joint_velocity_afferent_mask: uint8[126,11798], inferred anatomical support; zero means unsupported
arrays.atlas.joint_load_afferent_mask: uint8[126,11798], inferred anatomical support; zero means unsupported
arrays.atlas.body_rows: uint32[11798], identical to afferent_rows and in canonical MaleCNS order
arrays.atlas.body_mask: float32[11798,807], 1 permits physical BODY807 channel injection to an afferent row

decoder_contract.input: actual post-recurrence MaleCNS motor state, ordered by motor_rows
decoder_contract.reference_rate: separate float32[815] calibration tensor measured from an actual CNS calibration corpus; absent from this anatomical artifact
decoder_contract.normalization: center and reference-scale each motor row before decoding
decoder_contract.weights: learned signed weights multiplied by motor_mask at every forward pass
decoder_contract.output: bounded M92: body M90 in exact actuator order, then pharyngeal pump and salivary drive
decoder_contract.ranges: position rows 0:84 use body-schema bounds and signed centered outputs; adhesion and physiology rows 84:92 are [0,1]
decoder_contract.activation_dynamics: owned by the runtime ABI; this atlas does not fabricate muscle activation time constants
decoder_contract.muscle_warning: MOTOR92 is a servo/physiology target interface, not muscle recruitment; mask signs and servo directions are not anatomical claims
